invariants.rule: future Product decisions must not rename canonical item/capability identities
each accepted acquisition transaction changes authoritative inventory exactly once
enter_old_boundary availability derives from authoritative owned item/capability state, not a hidden QA worldFact
reload/retry cannot replay an already committed token grant
if Product selects a removal policy, reload/retry cannot remove an additional copy or restore a removed copy
old-boundary route availability is deterministic from authoritative persisted state
no token source/use/removal/repeatability choice may change Hard Work eligibility or reward

saveReload.beforeAcquisition: same authoritative ownership and route availability after reload
saveReload.afterAcquisition: one committed grant remains one committed grant
saveReload.afterRemovalIfSelected: removed inventory remains removed and route capability recomputes
